{{Top|leg}}
The '''Soka Fly''' was a kind of insect possibly native to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

During her incarceration at the [[Valorum Center]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Ovolot Qail Uthan]] bred Soka flies to keep herself sane and busy.
